title: Joplin Notes Sync Settings
description: Connection and sync options. Set your Joplin API token on the plugin's own page (Menu → Joplin Notes Sync); it's stored as a local secret, never here.

joplinUrl.title: General: Joplin Web Clipper URL
joplinUrl.description: Joplin's local Web Clipper address (Joplin → Options → Web Clipper).

parentNotebookTitle.title: General: Parent notebook
parentNotebookTitle.description: Joplin notebook that holds one sub-notebook per project.

syncIntervalSec.title: General: Auto-sync interval (seconds)
syncIntervalSec.description: How often to sync. 0 = manual only; minimum 15.

archiveRemovedNotes.title: General: Archive instead of delete
archiveRemovedNotes.description: Move notes removed from Super Productivity to an “Archive” sub-notebook instead of deleting them.

syncTaskNotes.title: Tasks: Sync task notes
syncTaskNotes.description: Sync each task's Notes field with a “Tasks” sub-notebook per project. Two-way; the most recent edit wins.

taskNotesOneWay.title: Tasks: One-way only (Super Productivity → Joplin)
taskNotesOneWay.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Never pull Joplin edits back; Super Productivity always wins.

syncArchivedTasks.title: Tasks: Keep archived tasks
syncArchivedTasks.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Archived tasks keep their Joplin notes (one-way) instead of being removed.

syncTaskTags.title: Task note extras: Tags
syncTaskTags.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Give each note the task's tags. One-way.

syncTaskDueDates.title: Task note extras: Due date and done state
syncTaskDueDates.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Make notes Joplin to-dos with the due date. Done state syncs both ways unless one-way is on.

syncTaskSubtasks.title: Task note extras: Subtask checklist
syncTaskSubtasks.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Append a read-only subtask checklist. One-way.

syncTaskTimeStats.title: Task note extras: Time spent / estimate
syncTaskTimeStats.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Append a time logged vs. estimated line. One-way.

syncTaskAttachments.title: Task note extras: Attachments
syncTaskAttachments.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Append links, images and file:// links (files aren't copied). One-way.

syncTaskIssueLinks.title: Task note extras: Issue reference
syncTaskIssueLinks.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Append the issue provider and id; a link only if the id is a URL. One-way.

syncTaskRepeatInfo.title: Task note extras: Repeat rule
syncTaskRepeatInfo.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Append the repeat rule, e.g. “Repeats every 2 weeks (Mon, Wed)”. One-way.

syncProjectIcons.title: Projects: Icons and colours
syncProjectIcons.description: Give each project notebook (and the “Daily summaries” notebook) an icon on a coloured tile. One-way.

syncProjectIndex.title: Projects: Task index note
syncProjectIndex.description: Needs “Tasks: Sync task notes”. Add an “Overview” note linking every task note in the project. One-way.

syncDailySummary.title: Daily summary: Write daily notes
syncDailySummary.description: One note per day in a “Daily summaries” notebook: tasks completed and time per task. Last 7 days refreshed each sync.

dailySummaryCharts.title: Daily summary: Add charts
dailySummaryCharts.description: Needs “Daily summary: Write daily notes”. Mermaid pie charts at the top of each note (Joplin's viewer renders them).
